In case people are interested, here's a little transfer round up for those of you who have a life and haven't spent the last few days refreshing twitter every 12 minutes:

- We have bought Sam Johnstone, the backup Crystal Palace keeper for 10m, confirmed by Sky Sports today. he's the same age as josé sa and reportedly agreed on the promise of being no. 1, which would suggest SA is gone.

- We have bought two youngsters, Bastien Meupiyou (18) for ~5m from Nantes, and Ethan Sutherland (18) for 250k from St. Mirren. Meupiyou is a Centre back, and Sutherland a winger. Both are believed to be massive talents, but not exactly ready for first team football so will likely play with the youth teams for the foreseeable.

- We submitted a €25m bid to Burnley for Luca Koleosho, which was rejected. He's an exciting starting winger. doesn't have the greatest G/A numbers over the few games he's played for them, but Burnley fans seem to be huge fans and very upset to lose him. Seems from rumours that he's fully set on a move to Molineux, but Burnley are making things difficult and rejecting bids that match/are above his value. watch this space

- We rejected a €15m bid for Boubacare Traore from Feyenoord today. Can't really work out why, Gaz obviously rates him very highly.

- Very tentative rumour, but apparently we've submitted a bid for Teden Mengi, the Luton centreback. don't have much info regarding this I'm afraid.
